info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Asset Securitization Management API
info.description: The Asset Securitization Management API allows users to modify existing asset securitization records within the banking treasury framework. This API is designed for financial institutions and treasury managers seeking to update asset configurations, manage risk profiles, or adjust terms. Typical consumers of this API include treasury operations teams and asset managers who require efficient tools for regulatory compliance and financial analysis. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure accurate records and streamlined updates essential for effective asset securitization strategies.
